preconditions.description: The number of nodes N in the linked list must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K[i] <= 100000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element K[i] in the linked list must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the linked list K must be equal to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the level order traversal of the constructed binary tree, which matches the input linked list K.
